stories.originalTitle: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
stories.summary: Organizations building applications powered by artificial intelligence (AI) face a recurring challenge: giving large language model (LLM) agents access to enterprise data lakes without duplicating integration logic across every agent and application. Most team
points: Organizations building applications powered by artificial intelligence (AI) face a recurring challenge: giving large language model (LLM) agents access to enterprise data
Most teams begin by wiring agents directly to databases and APIs, with no shared gateway such as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server in between.
Each new dataset demands custom code, and each agent reimplements its own access control.
